name: Retell AI
pricing_notes: Pay-as-you-go $0.07–$0.31/min depending on LLM/voice/telephony; $10 in free credits to start. Voice infra $0.055/min. Chat agents from $0.0005/msg. 20 concurrent calls free, then $8/concurrency/month. Phone numbers $2/month. No charge for SIP trunking/custom telephony. Enterprise: custom.
free_tier: Yes – $10 in free credits, then pay per minute
best_for: Developers and agencies wanting pay-as-you-go voice agents with no platform fee

name: Vapi
pricing_notes: No package: pre-paid $0.05/min hosting; transcriber, model and voice providers billed at cost; $5 free credits, 1 Vapi number, 4 concurrent calls. Core package: $29/month (10 concurrent calls, 5 numbers). Pro: 10% of hosting fee, $999/mo minimum (30 concurrent calls). Premier: custom. HIPAA add-on $2,000/month; extra concurrency $10/line/month.
features: Bring your own models (transcriber, LLM, voice)
4 concurrent calls with no package (10 on Core)
Free Vapi telephony/SIP, WebSockets and WebRTC transport
best_for: Engineering teams that want fine control over every model in the voice stack

name: Bland AI
pricing_notes: Start: $0.14/min talk time + $0.05/transfer min, $0 platform fee, 10 concurrent calls, 100 calls/day. Build: $0.12/min (+$0.04/transfer min) + $299/month platform fee, 50 concurrent calls, 2,000 calls/day. Enterprise: custom. Per-minute rate includes LLM, STT and TTS; telephony billed separately (BYO carrier or Bland's at pass-through cost).
free_tier: Start plan: 2 credits + inbound number, no card required
features: SOC 2, HIPAA with BAA on Enterprise (per site)
best_for: Teams wanting one predictable per-minute rate without token pass-throughs

name: Synthflow
pricing_notes: Sold only as an annual enterprise agreement scoped to call volume, concurrency, telephony, integrations, security needs and launch support. No free plan or trial and no per-minute rate. No agency plan; BPOs and software platforms can add white-label in the contract. (The pricing page no longer lists the previous 'from $30,000/year' figure.)
features: Custom routing, handoffs and fallback logic
CRM, calendar, contact-center and API integrations
SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, GDPR (per site)
best_for: Mid-market and enterprise contact centers wanting a managed deployment

name: ElevenLabs Agents
pricing_notes: ElevenAgents plans include call minutes: Free 15 min / 4 concurrent; Starter $6 (75 min / 6; first month $1); Creator $22 (275 min / 10, first month $11); Pro $99 (1,238 min / 20); Scale $299 (3,738 min / 30); Business $990 (12,375 min / 40); Enterprise custom. Extra minutes $0.08/min, burst $0.16/min, texts $0.003 each. LLM and telephony billed at cost.
features: Burst concurrency up to 3× plan limit
best_for: Builders who prioritise voice quality and already use ElevenLabs

name: Goodcall
pricing_notes: Starter $79/mo (100 unique customers, then 79¢); Growth $129/mo (500, then 26¢); Scale $299/mo (2,000, then 15¢). No per-minute charges. Local number included.
features: External tools: API, MCP server, code
best_for: Small service businesses that want a predictable monthly bill

name: Rosie
pricing_notes: Professional $49/mo (250 min); Scale $149/mo (1,000 min); Growth $299/mo (2,000 min). Annual billing: 2 months free. 7-day free trial. Add-ons: website chat free with all plans; website texting $50/mo (25 conversations, then $1 each).
best_for: Solo owners and home-service businesses that need a no-code AI receptionist
affiliate: Affiliate program mentioned on site; terms not verified

name: Dialora
pricing_notes: Dialora's pricing page describes plans as starting at $97/month and offers a free trial; the full plan table did not load when we checked.
features: Industry templates, trained on your docs
best_for: Small businesses and agencies running outbound lead follow-up

name: Upfirst
pricing_notes: Starter $24.95/mo (30 calls, then $1.50/call); Premium $59.95/mo (90 calls, then $1); Pro $159.95/mo (300 calls, then $0.75); Scale $299/mo (600 calls, then $0.70). Annual billing saves 20%. Extra agents $9.95/month. 14-day free trial.
features: Instant call summaries by text or email
Appointment scheduling (Google, Outlook, Clio, Acuity, Calendly, Square and more)
best_for: Very small businesses with modest call volume that want the lowest published entry price
affiliate: Affiliates page linked on site; terms not verified

name: Mistral Voxtral 3 Voice Agent API
pricing_notes: Voice agent API: $0.04/min with Mistral Small 4 for reasoning, $0.08/min with a larger model; covers transcription, reasoning and speech. Standalone models: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3 (batch) $0.0035/min, Realtime 3 $0.008/min, Small Transcribe 3 $0.004/min, Mini TTS 3 $13 per 1M characters. Phone numbers/telephony not included. Launched Oct 20, 2026.
features: Voice agent SDK built on LiveKit
SIP calling and WebRTC for browsers/apps
Transcription in 50+ languages; TTS in 35+ languages
Function calling, web search and retrieval
EU, US and global API endpoints, or self-deployment
best_for: Developers wanting a low bundled per-minute rate or EU-hosted / self-hosted voice agents

name: Cartesia Managed Agents
pricing_model: Subscription with prepaid agent usage + per-minute
pricing_notes: Managed Agents $0.03/min (previously $0.06/min) on every self-serve plan. Plans include prepaid agent dollars: Free $0 ($1/month, ~33 min; 1 number, 8 concurrent calls); Pro $5/mo ($5, 3 numbers, 12 concurrent); Startup $49/mo ($49, 5 numbers, 20 concurrent); Scale $299/mo ($299, 10 numbers, 60 concurrent); Enterprise custom. Telephony $0.014/min with a Cartesia-provided number; LLM usage billed separately. Calls continue at the plan rate after prepaid dollars run out. Launched Oct 29, 2026.
free_tier: Yes – $1/month prepaid agent usage (~33 min) + 20K TTS/STT credits
features: Voice models and agent harness co-designed (Sonic TTS, Ink STT)
Tool calls to backend APIs and CRMs
Agents in 44 languages (mid-call switching for 5 at launch)
SOC 2 Type II; DPAs/BAAs on Enterprise
best_for: Teams wanting a low per-minute managed voice agent from a voice-model vendor, from prototype to enterprise
